questions.q: What drives a sales order line through the sequence of fulfillment steps?
options: A manual email sent by the salesperson
The customer's own ERP system
The order orchestration engine, following the sequence configured for that order type
The General Ledger
questions.explain: Order orchestration tracks a line's position and automatically hands it to the next responsible system or person.

questions.q: Which Oracle Fusion areas perform the actual physical work of fulfillment?
options: Inventory Management and Shipping
Receivables and Cash Management
Order Management and General Ledger
Subledger Accounting and Fixed Assets
questions.explain: Order Management decides what should happen; Inventory Management and Shipping carry out picking, packing, and shipping.

questions.q: What does a sales order line's status (e.g., Awaiting Shipping) actually represent?
options: A random label with no real meaning
The chart of accounts segment used for that line
The customer's credit score
Where the line currently sits in the order orchestration sequence
questions.explain: The line's status reflects its current position in the orchestrated fulfillment sequence.

questions.q: If the Savannah warehouse were short on Model CP-220 units, what would Oracle Fusion do by default?
options: Silently pull the needed inventory from any other warehouse that has stock
Nothing automatic — the shortage has to be addressed directly, such as resourcing or splitting the shipment
Automatically cancel the entire order without notice
Automatically increase Harborview's credit limit
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion will not silently substitute a different ship-from organization; a shortage must be addressed deliberately.

questions.q: Why do the order and the ship-from warehouse need to agree?
options: Because only one warehouse can exist per company
Because warehouses and orders are stored in different currencies
Because inventory for a specific item must actually exist in the referenced inventory organization for the line to fulfill from there
Agreement is not actually required
questions.explain: The order references a specific ship-from organization, and inventory for that item must exist there for fulfillment to proceed.
